subject: Next steps: procurement pathing & vendor onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 Oct 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — procurement & payment pathing

Hi Samir — thanks for the demo earlier. Quick recap and the items we agreed to surface for your procurement team so you can pick a path (PO/invoice vs card vs marketplace):

- Preferred commercial path we discussed: annual subscription invoiced to a PO (you mentioned central procurement handles PO creation).
- Required docs for vendor setup: W-9 (US entity), vendor packet, bank/ACH details for payments.
- Vendor systems: you said Novus uses Coupa for vendor creation; you asked if we can accept invoices to AP@novushealth.com and whether we have a vendor code.

Attachments: attaching our standard vendor packet + W-9 for your team to upload to Coupa. Also adding a short Coupa intake guide in case you want to self-serve.

Can you confirm: 1) PO path works and who in your team will open the vendor profile (name/email), 2) expected PO lead time (30/45/60 days), and 3) whether you need Redwood to accept a different invoicing address?

Proposed next steps:
- Samir: confirm vendor contact + PO timeline (by Wed 10/06)
- Novus AP: upload W-9 + vendor packet to Coupa, or reply to this thread with required bank fields
- Internal (Ben/Mateo): I’ll assign follow-ups — Ben will prep the invoice template and standard SOW wording; Mateo will confirm banking options (ACH vs wire).

Thanks — attaching: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf, W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf, coupa_integration_guide.pdf

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189
From: Samir Patel <samir@novushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Marsh <lydia.marsh@novushealth.com>, vendor-ops@novushealth.com
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — procurement & payment pathing

Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap. We prefer PO/invoice routing for agreements > $10k; please proceed on that assumption for initial sizing.

A few notes from procurement:
- Novus uses Coupa; vendor-ops will need the completed vendor packet + W-9 to create the vendor record.
- Can you confirm Redwood’s legal entity name and tax ID to match Coupa fields? (we need exact strings)
- Payment terms: Net 45 is typical for us; will Redwood accept Net 45 on the first year?
- Invoices should be submitted to AP@novushealth.com; copy vendor-ops.

I’ve looped Lydia from Procurement — she’ll own the Coupa creation. Lydia, can you confirm if we need anything beyond the W-9 + banking info?

Thanks,
Samir
Director, Cloud Services — Novus Health
samir@novushealth.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Novus — PO path confirmed, actions assigned (Net45 ask)

Ben / Mateo / Dev — Samir confirmed PO/invoice as their preferred path and asked about Net45. Key asks: exact legal name + tax ID to provide to Coupa, vendor packet + W-9 upload, and invoice submission to AP@novushealth.com.

Please action:
- Ben: prepare a one-page invoice template and a short SOW summary showing the initial term and list price (so Procurement has line items for PO). Also confirm whether Redwood can accept Net45 for Year 1 (I think standard ops can, but please confirm).
- Mateo: check with Finance on payment routing options (ACH vs wire) and whether we can provide both fields in the vendor packet. Return ETA by EOD Tue (10/05).
- Dev: pre-fill the vendor packet with the Legal Entity name and signatory (I’m attaching the signed W-9 we have). Also produce the exact strings for Coupa fields (company name, tax id, address) so Samir can paste them into vendor-ops.

I’ll reply to Samir with the requested strings as soon as we have them.

Evelyn
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 08:39:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Novus — PO path confirmed, actions assigned (Net45 ask)

On it — quick status:
- Invoice template created (small sample attached internally). I will mark payment term as Net45 for the initial PO and include both ACH and wire instructions on the invoice.
- Confirmed with Finance: we can accept Net45 for the first year with standard credit hold checks; ACH is preferred for speed, but we will provide wire details as backup.
- Uploading a pre-populated vendor packet (internal) and a DocuSign link for signature if they prefer that route: https://docusign.com/envelope/DS-9876

Will send the exact Coupa field strings in a follow-up to Evelyn to paste into the vendor creation ticket.

—Ben
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Patel <samir@novushealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Marsh <lydia.marsh@novushealth.com>, vendor-ops@novushealth.com
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — procurement & payment pathing

Thanks all — we’ll begin vendor creation today. Lydia / vendor-ops: we’ve got the W-9 and vendor packet from Evelyn, I’ll upload to Coupa and create the PO request. Expected internal lead time: ~14 business days for PO issuance but I’ll flag it as expedited.

Evelyn / Ben — please send the two strings we need for Coupa (legal name + tax id) and the invoice template to AP@novushealth.com so we have everything in one place.

Appreciate the quick movement.

Samir
